# `purchase-draft` commands

## `purchase-draft cancel`

Cancel a saved purchase draft with expected_version, operation_key and reason. Preserve every revision and attribution; cancellation has no accounting effect and cannot be undone.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | approval.prepare |
| Additional resources | ledger.read: member |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/purchase-draft.cancel` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow purchase-draft cancel 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --expected-version 1 --operation-key draft-cancel-1 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Save supplier bill for review" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "purchase-draft cancel", "input": {"draft": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV", "expected_version": 1, "operation_key": "draft-cancel-1"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer | yes | no | — | minimum 1 |
| `operation_key` | `--operation-key` | string | yes | no | — | minimum length 1; maximum length 128 |

| Option | Meaning |

| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/purchase-draft.cancel`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
| `X-Bookflow-Reason` | conditional | Short reason; an agent or system write needs this or an active directive |
| `X-Bookflow-Source-Ref` | optional | Identifier of the source that triggered the write |
| `X-Bookflow-Directive` | conditional | Active directive code or id; alternative to reason for an agent or system write |
| `Idempotency-Key` | optional | Retry-safe key for this create command |

## `purchase-draft commit`

Release an approved purchase order, post an approved bill, or commit a saved draft with approvals off. Revalidates exact source and commercial evidence and current native posting rights; creates one reversible batch. Supply request version when approved.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | approval.prepare |
| Additional resources | ledger.read: member, ledger.post: standard |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/purchase-draft.commit` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow purchase-draft commit --draft 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --expected-version 3 --expected-request-version 2 --operation-key approval-example --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json --reason "Review supplier bill"`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:


| `expected_request_version` | `--expected-request-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | — |

## `purchase-draft create`

Save a native purchase draft with a reason and permanent operation_key. The draft posts nothing: no AP, ledger, inventory or purchase consumption. Use --dry-run for an exact unsaved preview. kind is bill or purchase_order; operation is create or correct with original_id and original_version. Sources and exact amounts are captured without reservations. Restore awaits native bill restoration. Another preparer can resume its shared ID.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | approval.prepare |
| Additional resources | ledger.read: member |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/purchase-draft.create` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow purchase-draft create --date 2026-09-15 --vendor 'Regional Parts' --expenses '[{"account":"Professional Fees","amount":"80.00"}]' --operation-key draft-save-1 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Save supplier bill for review" --json`

| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
| `X-Bookflow-Reason` | conditional | Short reason; an agent or system write needs this or an active directive |
| `X-Bookflow-Source-Ref` | optional | Identifier of the source that triggered the write |
| `X-Bookflow-Directive` | conditional | Active directive code or id; alternative to reason for an agent or system write |
| `Idempotency-Key` | optional | Retry-safe key for this create command |

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|

| `E_APPROVAL_STATE` | This draft state does not allow the requested act; inspect its legal next actions. |
| `E_COMPANY_AMBIGUOUS` | More than one company matches; use the id or Organization/Company. |
| `E_COMPANY_NOT_FOUND` | No such company. |
| `E_CONFIG_INVALID` | The configuration file could not be read. |
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |

| `E_DIRECTIVE_NOT_FOUND` | No such directive. |

| `E_GUARD_REFUSED` | Bookflow's own safety check in the database refused this write, so nothing was saved. This is a Bookflow bug, not a problem with your input or your disk: please report it with this error's details and request id. |
| `E_IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH` | That idempotency key was used for a different command or input. |

## `purchase-draft list`

List saved purchase drafts in stable ID order, optionally by lifecycle state. Continue with next_cursor; a cursor belongs to its state filter. These records never appear in AP aging or posted bill lists.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | approval.read |
| Additional resources | ledger.read: member |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/purchase-draft.list` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow purchase-draft list --state draft --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "purchase-draft list", "input": {"state": "draft"}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `--state` | literal["draft", "pending", "approved", "rejected", "committed", "cancelled"] \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `limit` | `--limit` | integer | no | no | 50 | minimum 1; maximum 200 |
| `cursor` | `--cursor` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/purchase-draft.list`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |

| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |

## `purchase-draft preview`

Revalidate a saved purchase draft and calculate its exact current total without saving or posting. The captured revision history stays unchanged. Use create --dry-run to preview a bill before saving.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | approval.read |
| Additional resources | ledger.read: member |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/purchase-draft.preview` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow purchase-draft preview 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "purchase-draft preview", "input": {"draft": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV"}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `draft` | `DRAFT` | string | yes | no | — | minimum length 1 |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/purchase-draft.preview`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |

### Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_COMPANY_AMBIGUOUS` | More than one company matches; use the id or Organization/Company. |
| `E_COMPANY_NOT_FOUND` | No such company. |
| `E_CONFIG_INVALID` | The configuration file could not be read. |
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |
| `E_DB_BUSY` | Another Bookflow command is running on this data root. |
| `E_FEATURE_DISABLED` | This feature is not enabled for the company. |
| `E_FS_UNKNOWN` | The filesystem type of the path could not be determined. |
| `E_GUARD_REFUSED` | Bookflow's own safety check in the database refused this write, so nothing was saved. This is a Bookflow bug, not a problem with your input or your disk: please report it with this error's details and request id. |
| `E_INACTIVE_REFERENCE` | A new or changed reference must name an active record. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_MIGRATION_FAILED` | A schema migration failed; the database was backed up first and is unchanged. |
| `E_NETWORK_SHARE` | The path is on a network filesystem, which Bookflow refuses to use. |
| `E_NOT_INITIALIZED` | The data root is not initialized; run `bookflow init`. |
| `E_NO_ACTOR` | This login is not mapped to a Bookflow user. |
| `E_ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND` | No such organization. |
| `E_PARTIAL_WRITE` | The authoritative write committed, but a secondary update remains incomplete. |
| `E_PERMISSION` | The acting user may not run this command here. |
| `E_REASON_REQUIRED` | This write needs a reason: a short phrase naming what triggered it (--reason on the CLI, a top-level reason on MCP, the X-Bookflow-Reason header on HTTP). |
| `E_RECORD_NOT_FOUND` | No such record. |
| `E_SCHEMA_BEHIND` | The database schema is behind this version of Bookflow; run `bookflow upgrade`. |
| `E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` | The database schema revision is not known to this version of Bookflow; upgrade Bookflow. |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | No valid credential: log in, or send a bearer token. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |

## `purchase-draft show`

Show the saved purchase draft, exact captured preview and immutable revision history, including cancelled drafts.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | approval.read |
| Additional resources | ledger.read: member |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/purchase-draft.show` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow purchase-draft show 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "purchase-draft show", "input": {"draft": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV"}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `draft` | `DRAFT` | string | yes | no | — | minimum length 1 |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/purchase-draft.show`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |

### Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_COMPANY_AMBIGUOUS` | More than one company matches; use the id or Organization/Company. |
| `E_COMPANY_NOT_FOUND` | No such company. |
| `E_CONFIG_INVALID` | The configuration file could not be read. |
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |
| `E_DB_BUSY` | Another Bookflow command is running on this data root. |
| `E_FEATURE_DISABLED` | This feature is not enabled for the company. |
| `E_FS_UNKNOWN` | The filesystem type of the path could not be determined. |
| `E_GUARD_REFUSED` | Bookflow's own safety check in the database refused this write, so nothing was saved. This is a Bookflow bug, not a problem with your input or your disk: please report it with this error's details and request id. |
| `E_INACTIVE_REFERENCE` | A new or changed reference must name an active record. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_MIGRATION_FAILED` | A schema migration failed; the database was backed up first and is unchanged. |
| `E_NETWORK_SHARE` | The path is on a network filesystem, which Bookflow refuses to use. |
| `E_NOT_INITIALIZED` | The data root is not initialized; run `bookflow init`. |
| `E_NO_ACTOR` | This login is not mapped to a Bookflow user. |
| `E_ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND` | No such organization. |
| `E_PARTIAL_WRITE` | The authoritative write committed, but a secondary update remains incomplete. |
| `E_PERMISSION` | The acting user may not run this command here. |
| `E_REASON_REQUIRED` | This write needs a reason: a short phrase naming what triggered it (--reason on the CLI, a top-level reason on MCP, the X-Bookflow-Reason header on HTTP). |
| `E_RECORD_NOT_FOUND` | No such record. |
| `E_SCHEMA_BEHIND` | The database schema is behind this version of Bookflow; run `bookflow upgrade`. |
| `E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` | The database schema revision is not known to this version of Bookflow; upgrade Bookflow. |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | No valid credential: log in, or send a bearer token. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |

## `purchase-draft submit`

Submit the exact saved purchase revision to the published one-step Review policy. Freezes commercial and source facts; posts nothing. Use operation_key and reason.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | approval.prepare |

## `purchase-draft update`

Replace all commercial fields of a saved purchase draft, carrying its exact expected_version, a new operation_key and reason. Omitted optional fields reset to defaults. Prior revisions remain readable; a cancelled draft refuses.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | approval.prepare |
| Additional resources | ledger.read: member |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/purchase-draft.update` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow purchase-draft update 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --date 2026-09-15 --vendor 'Regional Parts' --expenses '[{"account":"Professional Fees","amount":"80.00"}]' --expected-version 1 --operation-key draft-edit-1 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Save supplier bill for review" --json`

### Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_AMOUNT_PRECISION` | The amount has more decimal places than the currency allows. |
| `E_APPROVAL_STATE` | This draft state does not allow the requested act; inspect its legal next actions. |
| `E_COMPANY_AMBIGUOUS` | More than one company matches; use the id or Organization/Company. |
| `E_COMPANY_NOT_FOUND` | No such company. |
| `E_CONFIG_INVALID` | The configuration file could not be read. |
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |
| `E_DB_BUSY` | Another Bookflow command is running on this data root. |
| `E_DIRECTIVE_INACTIVE` | That directive has been deactivated. |
| `E_DIRECTIVE_NOT_FOUND` | No such directive. |
| `E_FEATURE_DISABLED` | This feature is not enabled for the company. |
| `E_FS_UNKNOWN` | The filesystem type of the path could not be determined. |
| `E_GUARD_REFUSED` | Bookflow's own safety check in the database refused this write, so nothing was saved. This is a Bookflow bug, not a problem with your input or your disk: please report it with this error's details and request id. |
| `E_IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH` | That idempotency key was used for a different command or input. |
| `E_INACTIVE_REFERENCE` | A new or changed reference must name an active record. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_MIGRATION_FAILED` | A schema migration failed; the database was backed up first and is unchanged. |
| `E_NETWORK_SHARE` | The path is on a network filesystem, which Bookflow refuses to use. |
| `E_NOT_INITIALIZED` | The data root is not initialized; run `bookflow init`. |
| `E_NO_ACTOR` | This login is not mapped to a Bookflow user. |
| `E_ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND` | No such organization. |
| `E_PARTIAL_WRITE` | The authoritative write committed, but a secondary update remains incomplete. |
| `E_PERMISSION` | The acting user may not run this command here. |
| `E_REASON_REQUIRED` | This write needs a reason: a short phrase naming what triggered it (--reason on the CLI, a top-level reason on MCP, the X-Bookflow-Reason header on HTTP). |
| `E_RECORD_NOT_FOUND` | No such record. |
| `E_SCHEMA_BEHIND` | The database schema is behind this version of Bookflow; run `bookflow upgrade`. |
| `E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` | The database schema revision is not known to this version of Bookflow; upgrade Bookflow. |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | No valid credential: log in, or send a bearer token. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |
| `E_VALUE_RANGE` | The value is outside its allowed range or storage bounds. |
| `E_VERSION_CONFLICT` | The record changed since the version you read. |

## `purchase-draft withdraw`

Withdraw pending or approved work using exact draft and request versions. Retains decisions and returns to draft. Approved withdrawal requires confirm=true after preview.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | approval.prepare |
| Additional resources | ledger.read: member |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/purchase-draft.withdraw` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow purchase-draft withdraw --draft 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --expected-version 3 --expected-request-version 2 --confirm --operation-key approval-example --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json --reason "Review supplier bill"`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "purchase-draft withdraw", "input": {"draft": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV", "expected_version": 3, "expected_request_version": 2, "confirm": true, "operation_key": "approval-example"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `draft` | `--draft` | string | yes | no | — | minimum length 1 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer | yes | no | — | minimum 1 |
| `operation_key` | `--operation-key` | string | yes | no | — | minimum length 1; maximum length 128 |
| `expected_request_version` | `--expected-request-version` | integer | yes | no | — | minimum 1 |
| `confirm` | `--confirm` | boolean | no | no | false | — |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--dry-run` | Validate and preview without writing. |
| `--reason TEXT` | Short reason for the write. |
| `--source-ref TEXT` | Identifier of the source that triggered the write. |
| `--interactive` | Prompt for input fields not supplied as arguments or options. |
| `--directive TEXT` | Standing-instruction code or id cited by the write. |
| `--idempotency-key TEXT` | Retry-safe key for this create command. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/purchase-draft.withdraw`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
| `X-Bookflow-Reason` | conditional | Short reason; an agent or system write needs this or an active directive |
| `X-Bookflow-Source-Ref` | optional | Identifier of the source that triggered the write |
| `X-Bookflow-Directive` | conditional | Active directive code or id; alternative to reason for an agent or system write |
| `Idempotency-Key` | optional | Retry-safe key for this create command |

### Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_APPROVAL_ASSIGNEE` | Only a currently assigned reviewer may decide this step. |
| `E_APPROVAL_POLICY` | The approval policy is incomplete or invalid. |
| `E_APPROVAL_REQUIRED` | This bill requires an approved purchase draft before posting. |
| `E_APPROVAL_SELF` | Self-approval is not permitted by this captured policy. |
| `E_APPROVAL_STALE` | The captured approval facts changed; withdraw and resubmit. |
| `E_APPROVAL_STATE` | This draft state does not allow the requested act; inspect its legal next actions. |
| `E_COMPANY_AMBIGUOUS` | More than one company matches; use the id or Organization/Company. |
| `E_COMPANY_NOT_FOUND` | No such company. |
| `E_CONFIG_INVALID` | The configuration file could not be read. |
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |
| `E_DB_BUSY` | Another Bookflow command is running on this data root. |
| `E_DIRECTIVE_INACTIVE` | That directive has been deactivated. |
| `E_DIRECTIVE_NOT_FOUND` | No such directive. |
| `E_FEATURE_DISABLED` | This feature is not enabled for the company. |
| `E_FS_UNKNOWN` | The filesystem type of the path could not be determined. |
| `E_GUARD_REFUSED` | Bookflow's own safety check in the database refused this write, so nothing was saved. This is a Bookflow bug, not a problem with your input or your disk: please report it with this error's details and request id. |
| `E_HAS_APPLICATIONS` | Unapply the active settlements before this change. |
| `E_IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH` | That idempotency key was used for a different command or input. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_MIGRATION_FAILED` | A schema migration failed; the database was backed up first and is unchanged. |
| `E_NETWORK_SHARE` | The path is on a network filesystem, which Bookflow refuses to use. |
| `E_NOT_INITIALIZED` | The data root is not initialized; run `bookflow init`. |
| `E_NO_ACTOR` | This login is not mapped to a Bookflow user. |
| `E_ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND` | No such organization. |
| `E_PARTIAL_WRITE` | The authoritative write committed, but a secondary update remains incomplete. |
| `E_PERIOD_CLOSED` | An affected accounting date is in a closed period. |
| `E_PERMISSION` | The acting user may not run this command here. |
| `E_REASON_REQUIRED` | This write needs a reason: a short phrase naming what triggered it (--reason on the CLI, a top-level reason on MCP, the X-Bookflow-Reason header on HTTP). |
| `E_RECORD_NOT_FOUND` | No such record. |
| `E_SCHEMA_BEHIND` | The database schema is behind this version of Bookflow; run `bookflow upgrade`. |
| `E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` | The database schema revision is not known to this version of Bookflow; upgrade Bookflow. |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | No valid credential: log in, or send a bearer token. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |
| `E_VERSION_CONFLICT` | The record changed since the version you read. |
